stem:
[Image: Grid with horizontal line segment AB]

Draw a triangle in the grid so that the line AB is the base of the triangle and the two new sides are the same length as each other.

descriptors: Triangle with two new sides equal (i.e. meeting on or within 2mm of the gridline that is the perpendicular bisector of AB)
Triangle with two new sides unequal
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: A square grid 10 units wide and 6 units high. A heavy horizontal line segment is drawn along the fourth horizontal grid line from the top (second from the bottom), spanning 3 grid units from the second vertical grid line from the left to the fifth vertical grid line from the left. The left endpoint of this segment is labeled 'A' directly below it, and the right endpoint is labeled 'B' directly below it.
